summary: Two TimePickers: segments plus a popover list of times, one in 12h with the default 15-minute step and one in 24h with a 30-minute step bounded to the afternoon.
use: Choosing an opening hour or an appointment time where the user can type it or pick it from a list.
spec: `<TimePicker label="Opens at" locale="en-US" hourCycle={12} bind:value={start} />` initialised with `new Time(9, 0)`

A second `<TimePicker` with `label="Closes at"`, `hourCycle={24}`, `step={30}`, `minValue={new Time(12, 0)}`, `maxValue={new Time(20, 0)}` and `description="Between 12:00 and 20:00, every 30 minutes."`
